use: each entry with a gene set is scored per spot (mean log1p-CPM over the genes present; a set with no present gene is dropped and recorded) and added to B_known (training spec 0.8) on top of N + Hallmark + Gavish + composition; every entry, scorable or not, is part of the novelty catalogue read by dbench.downstream.novelty
gene_set_policy: gene lists are the genes the declaration itself names, or a protocol marker set already used in this repository; they are NOT reconstructions of the papers' supplementary signatures, which are not read here; the reviewer may replace a set by the paper's own list before the B_known lock, as a new catalogue version
